informal_statement:
The auxiliary assertion consists of the following claims. The function \(D\) is continuous, even and nonnegative on \([-1,1]\), strictly increasing on \([0,1]\), and differentiable on \((-1,1)\). On the latter interval
\[
S'=-2D,
\]
and on the closed interval
\[
S(-z)=\lambda\pi-S(z).
\]
One has
\[
\gamma_\lambda>0;
\]
\(J,j\) are continuous on \([0,1]\);
\[
J(0)=J(1)=\gamma_\lambda;
\]

\[
J'=j
\]
on \((0,1)\); and
\[
J,H\geq\gamma_\lambda
\]
on \((0,1]\). Furthermore
\[
j>0
\]
on \((0,1/3)\),
\[
j(1/3)=0,
\]

\[
j<0
\]
on \((1/3,1)\), and
\[
H\geq J
\]
on \([1/3,1]\). On \((0,1/3)\),
\[
j'=8D'(2u-1)-4D'(u)<0
\]
and
\[
H'=-u[8D'(2u-1)-4D'(u)]>0.
\]
Finally
\[
H(u)\to\gamma_\lambda
\]
as \(u\downarrow0\).
